verdict.rationale: LM Studio has a download page that distributes the app and the headless llmster daemon. A hands-on user describes a 'simple install' on Windows with no Python environment setup, and its closed-source nature means there is no compile-from-source path. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-OS installers or package-manager packages, and clear evidence of solid Linux builds (one older community comment complains of no proper Linux support).
